channel.title: Hastings Daily: Politics
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: Bexhill county councillor leaves Reform UK to join Conservatives
item.description: A Bexhill county councillor has left Reform UK and joined the Conservative Party, the party's East Sussex group has said.

item.title: East Sussex energy group urges residents to contact MPs on heat pumps and EV targets
item.description: As the UN climate summit, COP31, begins in Turkey, the local community benefit society Energise Sussex Coast is calling on the government to restore heat pump funding, keep its current electric vehicle targets and reject the Rosebank oil field in the North Sea, according to the Hastings Online Times.

item.title: Hastings MP marks one-year anniversary of the beach 'beads' pollution incident
item.description: It is a year since Southern Water admitted responsibility for the millions of plastic beads that washed up on the beaches at Hastings, Camber Sands and at Rye Harbour Nature Reserve, and Hastings MP Helena Dollimore has marked the anniversary of what is thought to be one of the biggest plastic pollution incidents on the South Coast of England.

item.title: Councillor calls 500-home Bexhill plan a 'disaster zone waiting to happen'
item.description: A Bexhill town councillor has described proposals for a potential 500 new homes in the town as a 'disaster zone waiting to happen'.

item.title: Labour ends cooperation with Greens on 11 councils
item.description: Labour has withdrawn from power-sharing agreements with Green councillors in 11 local authorities, including Arun, Lewes and Wealden district councils in Sussex, over the party's ‘Zionism is Racism’ policy.

item.title: Devolution measures to bring £8m to Sussex and Brighton
item.description: Last week's budget included measures to give devolved local government in England a bigger share of its own tax revenues, the Hastings Online Times reports.

item.title: Bexhill councillor calls parking permit charges 'extortionate'
item.description: A Bexhill town councillor has branded the price of residential parking permits in the town 'extortionate and over the top'.

item.title: Eight Hastings and Bexhill residents arrested outside US embassy
item.description: Eight residents of Hastings and Bexhill were arrested outside the US embassy in London on Saturday 31 October, the Hastings Online Times reported. The group was peacefully holding signs reading 'I oppose genocide. I support Palestine Action'.

item.title: Coalition says October's budget cut the Warm Homes Plan by up to £5.7bn
item.description: A fuel poverty coalition says the government's October budget failed to protect households on the coast from volatile gas prices, and cut the Warm Homes Plan by up to £5.7 billion.

item.title: Update: Eastbourne MP calls for shuttle bus between Eastbourne and Hastings hospitals
item.description: The call for a shuttle bus between Eastbourne District General Hospital and the Conquest Hospital in Hastings has sparked widespread debate on The Herald's Facebook page, according to the paper. Many people commented in favour of the suggestion, while others asked practical questions, including what happens when a bus is full or whether people would need to book. Some readers said the focus should instead be on restoring all of Eastbourne DGH's services.

item.title: Bexhill MP backs petition for 20mph limit on Pevensey's B2191
item.description: The MP for Bexhill, Battle and the villages has backed a petition calling for a 20mph speed limit and weight restrictions on heavy goods vehicles through Pevensey and Westham.

item.title: Eastbourne MP calls for shuttle bus between Eastbourne and Hastings hospitals
item.description: Eastbourne MP Josh Babarinde has called for a dedicated shuttle bus between District General Hospital in Eastbourne and the Conquest Hospital in Hastings.

item.title: Eight Hastings and Rother residents renew challenge to MP over Palestine Action ban
item.description: Eight residents of Hastings, Bexhill and St Leonards who were arrested under the Terrorism Act have sent an open letter to Helena Dollimore MP, renewing their call for her to meet them on film to defend her vote to ban Palestine Action, according to the Hastings Online Times.

item.title: 173 residents urge Hastings MP to publicly oppose Rosebank oil field
item.description: A letter signed by 173 residents of the Hastings and Rye constituency has called on local MP Helena Dollimore to "get off the fence and publicly oppose all new oil and gas projects in the North Sea".

item.title: Hastings Greens split over national 'Zionism is racism' vote
item.description: The chair of Hastings Greens, Justin Lee Wynne, resigned his post and cancelled his party membership on Friday, citing an internal dispute over alleged bullying and his 'deeply uncomfortable' reaction to the national party's October 4 conference vote declaring the party 'anti-Zionist' and labelling Zionism as racism, the Hastings Independent Press reported.

item.title: Hastings and Rye MP criticises Bayeux Tapestry ticket phone system
item.description: The MP for Hastings and Rye has criticised the phone line the British Museum set up for local residents to book tickets for the Bayeux tapestry exhibition.

item.title: Warm Homes Plan cuts would be 'terrible blunder', local energy service warns
item.description: A local energy advice service has warned that cuts to the government's Warm Homes Plan would be a 'terrible blunder' for households across East Sussex.
